target_role: WhatsApp Business account admin / small business owner
workflow: Setting up and updating automated away messages and greeting messages
trigger: Off-hours or when the business is closed; need to customize messages per day or time
frequency: Daily or weekly (depending on business hours or marketing campaigns)
current_workaround: Manually toggling the away message on/off or editing the message text each time, because scheduling is not supported
consequence: Customers receive outdated or irrelevant auto-replies, leading to confusion or lost leads

workflow: Adding, editing, and organizing catalog items
trigger: New product launches, price changes, inventory updates
current_workaround: Manually re-entering data or uploading CSV files that often fail due to formatting issues
consequence: Catalog shows incorrect prices or out-of-stock items; potential loss of sales and customer trust

target_role: Business owner or IT admin managing multiple devices
workflow: Accessing WhatsApp Business on a secondary device (tablet, work phone, or via web)
trigger: Need to respond from multiple locations or devices
current_workaround: Logging out and logging in repeatedly, or using an unofficial multi-device hack that risks account ban
consequence: Account gets temporarily banned or chat history is lost when changing phones

target_role: Business admin verifying account for WhatsApp Business API
workflow: Undergoing business verification to access the WhatsApp Business API or advanced features
trigger: Need to send bulk messages, integrate with CRM, or use official API
frequency: Per-event (one-time but can become recurring if verification fails)
current_workaround: Repeatedly submitting documentation, contacting support with no clear feedback, or abandoning the process
consequence: Business cannot use official API, leading to manual bulk messaging or reliance on BSPs with high costs
